direction: Capacity-slack-aware multi-scale ruin scope with cluster-coherent sector destruction and stagnation-triggered tail randomization, dedicated to tight-capacity / clustered / eccentric-depot / size-100 regimes.

operations.mechanism: Round-5 confirmed (h_r2_ruin_depot_load_gate_rankpower supported) that normalized-savings x depot-gate x load/sparsity-gate with a stagnation rank schedule beats L3-ctrl (15.8374 vs 16.0781 SBS, all 24 feasible, 196 ms mean so ~10x headroom under the 2000 ms budget). Archive weakest regimes are tightly clustered: capacity_level=tight (rel gap -23.07%), size=100 (-21.78%), uniform demand (-21.53%), eccentric depot (-20.76%), clustered spatial (-19.98%), with zero exhausted/failed instances — so the loss is structural quality, not budget starvation. The KB L3 blueprint (method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3) prescribes exactly the multiplicative gate x rank-power ruin score and lists stagnation-aware diversification as its strong regime, and Shaw-relatedness ruin (method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret) motivates spatial contiguity of destroy sets for clustered instances. Therefore this round converts the regime-concentration clause into a testable, targeted mechanism: replace the binary load gate with a continuous capacity-slack exponent schedule and add angular/radial sector coherence, keeping the deterministic Regret-2 recreation, intra_2opt polish and R2R acceptance fixed so any delta is attributable to the destroy hook alone.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 2000 ms, a score_ruin_nodes that (a) rescales normalized removal savings by a capacity-slack factor raised to an iter_frac-scheduled exponent so that near-full routes (load/Q > 0.9) are progressively shielded while slack-rich routes stay destroyable early, (b) adds a sector-coherence term keyed on |cos(angle to depot)| and radial distance so ruin sets stay spatially contiguous on clustered geometries, and (c) injects a stagnation_ratio-driven randomized mid-tail component (rank exponent rising from ~0 to ~1.5 on stagnation) will lower the mean objective below the round-5 SBS of 15.8374, with the largest absolute reductions on tight-capacity, clustered-spatial, eccentric-depot and size-100 instances, since the existing rule's uniform load gating mis-sizes ruin scope when capacity slack is the binding constraint.
